duration.unit: journey stages reached: engine consume counter + 1 for the opening crisis; route burns add responses but not journey stages

fitness.sampling: One sample before player actions at each ordinary crisis response, including opening/Re-entry; excludes route burns, route choices and terminal snapshots. Ordinary turns count these playable responses, not hypothetical distance.

crewSelection.draw: Once per run, seeded; no mid-run replacements

missionPolicy: Heuristic one-shot timing/choices and Kim redraw; no optimal future planning.
fabricationPolicy: No construction planning; fabrication is not used by this heuristic.
